fixed.explanation: IntervalArray.__arrow_array__ called pyarrow.from_numpy_dtype on the subtype, and that call fails for DatetimeTZDtype. It now builds pyarrow.timestamp(unit, tz) for tz-aware subtypes. ArrowIntervalType serialized the subtype as text and read it back with type_for_alias, which has no name for tz-aware timestamps. It now stores the tz as a separate metadata key, and deserialization rebuilds the timestamp type with it. Metadata written before this change has no tz key and still reads back as before.

query.intent: IntervalArray.__arrow_array__ converts the subtype to an arrow type using pyarrow.from_numpy_dtype, which fails for extension dtypes like DatetimeTZDtype. Also ArrowIntervalType (pandas arrow extension type for intervals) serializes the subtype as a string in __arrow_ext_serialize__ and deserializes it with pyarrow.type_for_alias, which fails for tz-aware timestamps.
query.symptom: pa.array of a Series of intervals with tz-aware datetime subtype raises TypeError, and parquet round trip fails with no type alias for the timestamp.

history.analysis: IntervalArray.__arrow_array__ uses pyarrow.from_numpy_dtype on the subtype, which fails for DatetimeTZDtype. ArrowIntervalType stores the subtype as str and restores it with type_for_alias, which fails for tz-aware timestamps. Both need changes.
